name: Myanmar
value: Airstrikes continue; no major city falls
summary: Military airstrikes kill five in Mon State on 15–16 Nov and intensify in Shan's Mongmit; no major city changes hands
state: Military airstrikes on two villages near Yechaungphyar, Mon State, on 15 and 16 Nov killed five people and injured about 15 in an area with no reported fighting (IMNA, 23 Nov). Mizzima reported on 24 Nov that the military has stepped up airstrikes in Mongmit township, Shan State, against resistance advances, after a 13 Nov strike on a Rakhine displacement camp killed 12. Searches on 25 Nov found no major city changing hands and no cross-border escalation, so Watch holds.
for_you: Civilians in Rakhine, Sagaing, Shan and Mon states face airstrikes and displacement. FCDO advises against all but essential travel to much of Myanmar.
rubric_hit: Watch: civil war at sustained intensity; no major city fallen, no cross-border escalation

sources.title: IMNA — Two more airstrike victims die while receiving treatment in Yechaungphyar

why: A multi-sided civil war affecting 50 million people, with spillover to China, Thailand, India and Bangladesh.
drivers: Resistance offensives, junta airstrikes, Chinese mediation, elections, humanitarian access.

rubric.alert: Major city falls, mass-casualty airstrikes, or cross-border escalation.
